high-protein-gym.savings_summary: Zero-Waste Macro Plan: All 3 high-protein dishes share Red Onions, Local Garlic, Paprika, and Cold Pressed Sunflower Oil so every shilling goes into lean protein and fresh greens.

meals.title: Paprika Chicken Breast, Sweet Potato Mash & Sukuma
meals.description: Juicy seared chicken breast with spiced sweet potato mash and garlicky sautéed sukuma wiki.
steps: Boil cubed sweet potatoes in salted water on the stove for 14 minutes until fork-tender, then mash coarsely.
Rub chicken breast fillets with paprika, black pepper, salt, and 1/2 tbsp sunflower oil.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet on medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then slice.
In the same pan, sauté half the diced red onion and garlic for 1 minute, toss in shredded sukuma wiki, and wilt for 3 minutes.
Plate sliced chicken beside warm sweet potato mash and bright green sukuma wiki.

meals.title: Chicken Mince & Quinoa Power Skillet with Egg
meals.description: Savory spiced chicken mince tossed with fluffy quinoa, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and a soft-fried egg.
steps: Rinse quinoa and simmer in 2 parts salted water on the stove for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Brown the chicken mince with red onion, garlic, paprika, and black pepper in sunflower oil for 6–7 minutes.
Fold in halved cherry tomatoes and baby spinach until wilted, then stir through the cooked quinoa.
Fry two eggs sunny-side up in a small non-stick pan for 3 minutes.
Serve the power bowl hot, crowned with the runny-yolk eggs.

meals.title: High-Protein Chicken & Avocado Tortilla Quesadilla
meals.description: Crispy toasted tortilla wraps stuffed with leftover seared chicken breast, cheddar, hoho peppers, and avocado.
steps: Pan-sear thin strips of chicken breast with paprika, salt, hoho slices, and red onion on the stove for 5 minutes.
Lay tortilla wraps flat, layer half of each with grated cheddar and the warm spiced chicken mix.
Fold tortillas in half and toast on a dry or lightly oiled skillet for 2 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Slice into triangles and serve immediately alongside fresh sliced avocado.

20-min-quick.savings_summary: Zero-Waste Speed Plan: Uses one pack of Tortilla Wraps, Cherry Tomatoes, Baby Spinach, and Teriyaki Sauce across 3 rapid 15-minute weeknight meals.

meals.title: 15-Min Teriyaki Chicken & Broccoli Udon
meals.description: Thick Japanese udon noodles tossed in glossy teriyaki glaze with tender chicken thighs and crisp broccoli.
steps: Boil udon noodles in a pot on the stove for 6 minutes; drop tenderstem broccoli in for the last 2 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, sear chicken thigh strips in hot sunflower oil for 5 minutes until browned.
Add minced garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in teriyaki sauce and a splash of noodle water.
Toss drained udon and broccoli into the skillet for 1 minute until glossy and serve hot.

meals.title: Creamy Basil Pesto Penne with Spinach & Tomatoes
meals.description: Al dente penne coated in Kaputei basil pesto, blistered cherry tomatoes, and wilted baby spinach.
steps: Cook penne rigate in boiling salted water on the stove for 9 minutes until al dente.
While pasta boils, blister cherry tomatoes in a skillet with sunflower oil for 3 minutes.
Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, drain penne, and toss into the skillet off the heat with pesto, spinach, and pasta water.
Plate and top with crumbled feta cheese.

meals.title: Tuna, Avocado & Feta Crunch Wraps
meals.description: No-fuss toasted wraps layered with John West tuna steak, creamy avocado, spinach, and crumbled feta.
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt; flake in drained tuna steak.
Spread the tuna-avocado mix over warm tortilla wraps, then top with baby spinach, cherry tomatoes, and feta.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down on a hot dry skillet for 90 seconds per side.
Cut diagonally and serve warm.

kenyan-comfort.savings_summary: Zero-Waste Nairobi Comfort: Round Tomatoes, Red Onions, Garlic, Ginger, and Coconut Milk power a comforting 3-day Kenyan rotation with zero wasted produce.

meals.title: Coconut Chicken Drumstick Curry & Matoke
meals.description: Braised chicken drumsticks simmered in Kentaste coconut milk with tender matoke bananas and tomatoes.
steps: Brown chicken drumsticks in sunflower oil in a deep sufuria on the stove for 6 minutes.
Add diced red onions, garlic, ginger, and curry powder; sauté until fragrant.
Stir in chopped round tomatoes and cook down into a thick sauce for 5 minutes.
Nestle in peeled matoke, pour in coconut milk and 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer gently for 18 minutes until matoke is tender.

meals.title: Ndengu (Green Grams) in Coconut with Sukuma Wiki
meals.description: Creamy Kenyan coconut ndengu stew paired with crisp sautéed sukuma wiki and fresh avocado.
steps: Rinse ndengu and boil in plenty of water on the stove for 25 minutes until tender; drain excess water.
In a saucepan, sauté red onion, garlic, carrots, and tomatoes in sunflower oil until soft.
Stir in cooked ndengu, remaining coconut milk, and a pinch of curry powder; simmer 5 minutes until creamy.
Quickly sauté shredded sukuma wiki in a separate pan with a pinch of salt and serve together with sliced avocado.

meals.title: Kenyan Masala Chicken Thighs & Home-Style Potatoes
meals.description: Pan-braised spiced chicken thighs with golden pan-fried white potatoes, hoho, and tomato-onion gravy.
steps: Pan-fry cubed white potatoes in 1 tbsp sunflower oil on medium heat for 12 minutes until golden and crisp; set aside.
In the same pan, sear seasoned chicken thighs skin-side down for 7 minutes, flip, and cook 5 minutes more.
Add sliced red onions, hoho, ginger, chopped tomatoes, and crumbled stock cube with a splash of water.
Simmer covered for 8 minutes, fold in the golden potatoes briefly to coat in the gravy, and serve hot.

clean-plant-forward.savings_summary: Zero-Waste Plant-Forward Plan: Shares Chickpeas, Tofu, Red Onions, Garlic, Baby Marrow, and Olive Oil across 3 vibrant meat-free bowls.

meals.title: Crispy Sesame-Soy Tofu & Courgette Quinoa Bowl
meals.description: Golden seared tofu cubes glazed in soy sauce over fluffy quinoa, sautéed courgettes, and fresh avocado.
steps: Simmer rinsed quinoa in salted water on the stove for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Pat tofu dry, sear in olive oil on medium-high heat for 6 minutes until crisp on edges, then splash with soy sauce.
Sauté sliced courgettes and garlic in the same skillet for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Assemble bowls with quinoa, garlicky courgettes, glazed tofu, and fresh avocado slices.

meals.title: Spiced Chickpea & Butternut Coconut Stew
meals.description: Velvety braised butternut squash and Cooks & Co chickpeas simmered with turmeric, cumin, and palak spinach.
steps: Sauté diced red onion and garlic in olive oil on the stove for 3 minutes, then bloom cumin and turmeric.
Add cubed butternut squash, chickpeas, coconut milk, and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 15 minutes until squash is tender.
Fold in chopped palak spinach for 2 minutes until bright green and wilted.
Serve warm with a squeeze of fresh lemon.

meals.title: Charred Eggplant, Courgette & Herb Couscous
meals.description: Fluffy La Molisana couscous tossed with pan-charred eggplant, courgettes, lemon juice, and parsley.
steps: Steep couscous in equal parts boiling salted water off the heat for 6 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Pan-char diced eggplant and courgettes in olive oil with cumin on medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Toss warm roasted vegetables and fresh diced tomatoes through the couscous.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and black pepper.

budget-saver.savings_summary: Maximum Value Plan: Stretches one 12-pack of Isinya Eggs, 1kg Cabbage, 1kg Potatoes, and 1kg Green Peas across 3 filling meals under KES 450/serving.

meals.title: Kenyan Egg & Cabbage Fried Rice-Style Potato Skillet
meals.description: Hearty pan-fried potatoes, crunchy white cabbage, carrots, and scrambled eggs seasoned with garlic and pepper.
steps: Pan-fry small-diced white potatoes in sunflower oil on the stove for 10 minutes until tender and golden.
Push potatoes to the side, sauté red onion, carrots, and shredded cabbage for 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour beaten eggs into the center, scramble softly, then fold everything together.
Season well with salt and black pepper and serve hot.

meals.title: Slow-Simmered Green Peas & Potato Stew with Palak
meals.description: Wholesome whole green peas and potatoes simmered in a rich tomato-onion base with fresh palak greens.
steps: Boil soaked green peas in water on the stove for 25 minutes until tender.
Sauté red onion and diced tomatoes in sunflower oil until jammy, then stir in curry powder.
Add cubed potatoes, cooked green peas, and 1 cup of cooking liquid; simmer 12 minutes until potatoes are soft and broth thickens.
Stir in chopped palak for 2 minutes before serving.

meals.title: Savory Cabbage, Egg & Tomato Shakshuka Toast
meals.description: Spiced tomato-pepper shakshuka with poached eggs served alongside warm whole-meal toast.
steps: Sauté sliced red onion and finely shredded cabbage in sunflower oil on the stove for 4 minutes.
Add chopped round tomatoes and simmer 6 minutes until saucy.
Make 3 wells in the sauce, crack an egg into each, cover, and cook 4–5 minutes until whites are set.
Toast slices of whole meal bread in a dry pan and serve for scooping.
